dimensions.description: Optional resolutions are selected only when they match the player's actual approach.
Player-facing narration contains only player-visible knowledge.
Established/protected facts are not contradicted, strengthened, or silently extended.
Observation, inference, speculation, and unknowns remain distinct.
Interactable or decision-relevant details are not silently created as atmosphere.
Missing context is treated as unavailable information, not as absence in the world.
Established promises, facts, and consequences are remembered and paid off.
The DM does not replace the player's chosen approach with another action.
Failure changes or constrains the situation without arbitrarily ending play.
Improvisation is energetic in explicitly flexible space and restrained elsewhere.
Presentation is succinct, engaging, situationally humorous, and serious when appropriate.
The DM avoids unnecessary checks, obstacles, repetition, and exposition.
The DM requests resolution through the broker and waits for engine results before outcome narration.
